1.title: ‘She’s One of Us’: Mary Peltola’s Bumpy Rise to Political Power
1.summary: Ms. Peltola, the Democratic Senate candidate in Alaska, has complicated politics: She is pro-gun, pro-oil and pro-gas — but also pro-environment and especially pro-fish.

2.title: Saturday Night, No Mask Required, at the Last Ditch Lesbian Bar in Massachusetts
2.summary: Last Ditch, a bar and art space, ended its Covid mask requirement as a way to attract more people. What it got instead was outsized attention.

3.title: One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey
3.summary: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia found themselves in the path of the powerful weather system.

4.title: 5 Men Arrested on Suspicion of Terrorism Offenses Near RAF Fairford, Air Base Used by U.S.
4.summary: British counterterrorism police said the men were arrested after three suspicious vehicles appeared to be traveling toward R.A.F. Fairford early on Sunday.

5.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
5.summary: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.

6.title: Ten climbers missing after avalanche hits Himalayan base camp
6.summary: The Nepali team was preparing to take overseas climbers up the Himlung Himal peak.
